Package foms.controller

Class BranchController

java.lang.Object
foms.controller.BranchController
public class BranchController extends Object
The BranchController class is responsible for controlling operations related to branches within the system. This includes managing branches, payment methods, and menu items, such as opening and closing branches, adding or removing payment methods, and editing menu items.
Since:
2024-04-20

    • openBranches

      public static boolean openBranches(String name, String location, ArrayList<MenuItem> menuItemsList, int staffQuota, int staffCount, int managerCount, int managerQuota)
      Opens a new branch with the specified details.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the new branch.
      location - The location of the new branch.
      menuItemsList - List of menu items for the new branch.
      staffQuota - The staff quota for the new branch.
      staffCount - Initial count of staff.
      managerCount - Initial count of managers.
      managerQuota - The manager quota for the new branch.
      Returns:
      true if the branch was successfully added, false if a branch with the same name already exists.
